source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Electrical, p.6Y-27

procedures.title: Breakerless (magnetic pulse) distributor: disassemble and reassemble
steps: Reassemble by doing the removal steps in reverse order.

procedures.title: Breakerless (magnetic pulse) distributor: install
steps: Confirm the engine is at No. 1 firing position (balancer mark on the pointer).
Lay a new distributor-to-block gasket on the block.

Set the rotor to the housing mark made at removal, then install the distributor so the vacuum diaphragm points about 45° forward on the right side of the engine and the rotor points at the No. 1 cap contact.
Fit the clamp with the screw loose enough to turn the distributor for timing.
Put the No. 1 plug wire in the tower marked on the old cap, then the rest clockwise in firing order 1-8-4-3-6-5-7-2.
Connect the distributor-to-coil primary wires.
Install the cap.
Set timing, then fully tighten the clamp screw.
Connect the vacuum line.
Connect the tachometer drive cable.
Refit the ignition shields.

procedures.title: Breakerless distributor: off-engine test
steps: Check centrifugal and vacuum advance on a distributor tester or synchroscope adapted for this distributor.
Since it requires removal, leave this test until other system checks are done.
notes: No dwell reading is possible on this distributor, and the advance mechanisms are unlikely to cause trouble.

procedures.title: Ignition coil: replace
steps: Disconnect the ignition switch and distributor leads at the coil; on radio-equipped Corvettes, first remove the ignition shield bolts.
Pull the high-tension wire from the coil center terminal.
Remove the 2 coil support bolts, or loosen the friction clamp screw, and remove the coil.
Fit the new coil and install the bolts or tighten the clamp.
Seat the high-tension lead firmly in the center terminal and reconnect the switch and distributor primary leads; refit the ignition shield on Corvettes.
Start the engine and check coil operation.

procedures.title: Ignition pulse amplifier: disassemble and check components
steps: Remove the amplifier bottom plate.
Note where each lead connects to the panel board.
Remove the 3 panel board screws and lift the assembly out of the housing.
Note the markings and positions of the 2 transistors on the panel board and heat sink.
Note the insulators between transistors and heat sink, and between heat sink and panel board.
Remove the transistor screws and separate the 2 transistors and the heat sink from the board.
Inspect the panel board carefully for damage.
For component checks, use an ohmmeter with a 1-1/2 volt cell on its low range unless told otherwise.
Unsolder capacitors C2 and C3 at the points shown in figure 18i of the manual before checking the board.
For each check, connect the ohmmeter as shown, then reverse the leads for a second reading (circuit in figure 19i).
notes: Avoid overheating the panel board when soldering; clip away any epoxy and apply new commercially available epoxy.
